notes: Testing preview: Windows and Linux installed-update qualification is not complete. This prerelease does not claim platform qualification. Windows Authenticode is deferred. Preview de prueba: la cualificación de actualización instalada en Windows y Linux no está completa. Esta versión preliminar no declara cualificación de plataforma. Authenticode de Windows está aplazado. GitOdile 0.2.0-preview.10 This testing preview is the first GitOdile release produced by the single release pipeline: one run validates the tagged source, builds, records the operating-system trust boundary, applies the Tauri updater signature, stages and publishes the Windows x86-64 and Linux x86-64 packages. It is intended as the installed starting point of a real preview-to-preview update test. Windows is provided as an NSIS installer. Authenticode remains deliberately deferred, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Linux is provided as an AppImage. Both packages verify updates with the production Tauri updater key and the public preview.json feed in martinezelx/gitodile. macOS remains disabled and no macOS package is included. Publishing this preview does not declare either target qualified and does not authorize stable publication.
